svg.data-weight: 23.6 kg chassis with midplane, fan tray and air filter; 58.1 kg maximum configuration (Table 88)
svg.data-power-typical-scope: AC typical power draw from the MX Series family datasheet, which names no configuration, ambient or side; DC 1690 W
svg.data-cooling-system-w: 85 W high-capacity (70 W normal); dedicated PSU tap, excluded from the output-power budget per the guide note
svg.data-psu-system-output: AC normal-capacity 2054 W low-line / 1590 W high-line; DC normal-capacity 1600 W (Table 95, SYSTEM output for the required PSU set - no per-module nameplate is published)
svg.data-max-thermal-output: AC 7161 BTU/h (2100 W); DC 5074 BTU/h (1488 W) (environmental table; provisioning ceiling)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C in shipping container
svg.data-seismic: Designed to meet Telcordia Technologies Zone 4 earthquake requirements (environmental table wording, transcribed)
